name: Off-Nadir Delta API
description: Query geolocated world event signals (Delta Signals), what changed about them, satellite imagery and collection planning, the Watchlist, and the World Brief. Authenticate with an API key (Authorization: Bearer ond_… or X-API-Key). Available on every plan; what a call returns follows the key owner's plan, and metered calls spend its token balance. The MCP server at POST /api/v1/mcp serves the conversational subset as tools; for a ChatGPT custom GPT, import /api/v1/openapi-gpt-actions.json.
